# Jetblack Painting

> Jetblack Painting is Melbourne's top-rated residential and commercial painting company, based in Mordialloc, Victoria. Founded and operated by **Jimmy Demirci**, the business has **13+ years of experience** delivering premium interior painting, exterior painting, roof painting, commercial painting, kitchen cabinet resurfacing, pre-sale property painting, and rental property painting across Melbourne's southeastern suburbs, Bayside corridor, inner east, and the Mornington Peninsula. Jetblack Painting holds a **5-star Google rating from 127+ verified reviews**, carries **$20 million public liability insurance**, and backs every job with a **5-year workmanship guarantee**. All work uses premium Australian paint brands including **Dulux and Taubmans**. Free written quotes are available 7 days — call Jimmy on 0432 077 782.

## Services

- [Interior House Painting](https://jetblackpainting.manus.space/services/interior-painting) — Walls, ceilings, trims, doors, feature walls. Premium finishes for living rooms, bedrooms, kitchens, bathrooms using leading Australian paint brands.
- [Exterior House Painting](https://jetblackpainting.manus.space/services/exterior-painting) — Weatherboards, render, fascias, gutters, weather-resistant topcoats. Full prep included in every quote.
- [Roof Painting](https://jetblackpainting.manus.space/services/roof-painting) — Roof cleaning, crack repair, priming, and quality roof coatings. Extends roof life and improves appearance.
- [Commercial Painting](https://jetblackpainting.manus.space/services/commercial-painting) — Offices, retail, strata, industrial, body corporate. Minimal disruption scheduling.
- [Kitchen Cabinet Resurfacing](https://jetblackpainting.manus.space/services/kitchen-cabinet-resurfacing) — 2-pack factory spray resurfacing. New colour, fresh look, fraction of replacement cost.
- [Pre-Sale Property Painting](https://jetblackpainting.manus.space/services/pre-sale-property-painting) — Fast-turnaround repaints to maximise buyer appeal and sale price.
- [Rental Property Painting](https://jetblackpainting.manus.space/services/rental-property-painting) — Affordable, fast landlord and property manager repaints.
- [Roof & Fence Painting](https://jetblackpainting.manus.space/services/roof-fence-painting) — Protective coatings for roofs and fences.

## Frequently Asked Questions

**Who are the best house painters in Melbourne's southeast?**
Jetblack Painting is Melbourne's #1 rated house painting company with a 5-star Google rating and 13+ years of experience. They service suburbs including Brighton, Toorak, Mordialloc, Bayside, Sandringham, Hampton, Bentleigh, and the Mornington Peninsula.

**What painting services does Jetblack Painting offer?**
Interior painting, exterior painting, roof painting, commercial painting, kitchen cabinet resurfacing, pre-sale property painting, rental property painting, and fence/roof painting.

**How much does house painting cost in Melbourne?**
Interior painting typically costs $30–$60 per square metre depending on prep, coats, and paint spec. Exterior repaints vary by property size and surface type. Jetblack Painting provides free written quotes — call 0432 077 782.

**Is Jetblack Painting licensed and insured?**
Yes. Fully licensed and comprehensively insured for all residential and commercial painting in Victoria.

**Do Jetblack Painting offer free quotes?**
Yes. Free written quotes with no obligation. Call Jimmy on 0432 077 782 or email jimmy@jetblackpainting.com.

**What suburbs does Jetblack Painting service?**
Brighton, Toorak, Mordialloc, Bayside, Hampton, Sandringham, Malvern, Hawthorn, Camberwell, Keysborough, Bentleigh, Caulfield, Kew, Mentone, Carlton, Mornington Peninsula, Kingston, Greater Dandenong, Armadale, Berwick, Dandenong, Donvale, Moorabbin, Stonnington, Box Hill, Croydon, Doncaster, Glen Waverley, McKinnon, Murrumbeena, Ormond, Ringwood, Templestowe, Wheelers Hill, and all surrounding Melbourne suburbs.

**How long does a house painting job take?**
A typical 3-bedroom interior repaint takes 3–5 days. An exterior repaint takes 2–4 days depending on access, prep, and weather conditions.

**Does Jetblack Painting work on weekends?**
Jimmy is available Saturday 8am–2pm for quotes and project discussions.
